scope: Gitea open action: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.3 action row extended with one existing-style button for Gitea only. Awwwards references are research only.
designDecisions: Gitea open: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.3 (Gitea only) adds `Gitea'yı aç` after `Durdur` with the existing ActionButton style and §9 error dialog; no new colour, icon or motion; nothing taken from Awwwards.

UI6b/UI9: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.5 S3 notice with the approved P-12 sentence, placed below the Settings title on Tv.Attention.Soft with a Tv.Attention border and the ▲ state glyph; UI9 deletes the hidden legacy host without visible change. Nothing taken from Awwwards.

UI8: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §10 and P-41 specify SystemColors brushes, exact Turkish title-bar accessibility names, Gece/Gün screenshot filenames and README arrangement. §3.4 already controls reduced motion and chain animations; no visual style or interaction was copied from Awwwards.

UI7: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.5 supplies Hakkında with R5 version, short source commit and README/SECURITY links; UI7/P-40 supplies the exact native tray menu order, Turkish labels, default action and §9 status sentence. P-40 and TI1 preserve worklog card appearance and existing TrayIconArt; no design decisions were imported from Awwwards.

UI5: Prague Quadrennial archive/timeline and Just Nice Events were consulted as research, without copying art, motion or components. DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.4 alone determines chronological day headings, severity/time/summary/service and expandable detail, filters Tümü/Sorunlar/Onarımlar/Yaşam döngüsü, and Ham günlüğü göster.

UI5: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.4 requires the existing 2-second raw tail only while its panel is visible and §6 reuses the redacted bounded EvidencePanel. The selected UI uses existing Tv.Surface/SurfaceRaised/SurfaceSunken, Tv.Border, Tv.AccentSoft, Tv.Radius and Tv.Type tokens for minor gaps, without new colours, fonts, icons or animation.

UI4: Awwwards Services Layout from WKNDHRS and the Project Details Page - Desktop from Sai Narayanan were reviewed as inspiration only; no new user-facing controls or design patterns were imported. Live data/actions and WPF UI visuals remain grounded in DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.3.

UI4: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §5.1 requires 56px rows with name/role/relative check time/overflow and §6 defines StatusPill/ServiceRow/EvidencePanel. §5.3 defines the 40px logo, Repair/Restart/Stop actions, live elapsed banner, status/events/technical evidence tabs and explicit manual-stop warning; only Tv token scales are used in unspecified minor layout gaps.

UI3: Awwwards Renxa Recruit Site data visualization and Awwwards data-visualization inspiration were reviewed as research only; no external shapes, palettes, timing or interaction patterns were copied.

UI3: DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER 5.1 and 7.3 supply the 112px pulse arcs and snapshot-derived Turkish headline, chain strip, 56px service rows and metrics; 5.2 plus P-33 require the real full chain page with a 360px side sheet and the exact five-state legend. Only existing Tv tokens and the approved chain-node/flow model were used; UI8 owns the remaining idle CPU optimization.

N7: Awwwards Prague Quadrennial archive inspiration page has the archive/history/timeline tags and a related interactive timeline. This is qualitative reference only; the actual WPF UI keeps the approved Control Center typography, Tv token palette, session list plus details and native platform controls. No external animation or new imagery is imported.

N7: the original UI2 history placeholder is replaced with accessible project, actor and outcome filters; cards show start/end/step/file/outcome and matching timeline/evidence, as specified in DESIGN-WORKLOG §8. Empty state uses the exact approved Turkish sentence.

DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §4 Shell: 48 px native title bar, 72/232 px rail, exact Turkish labels/SymbolRegular icons, AccentSoft selection and 3 px Accent edge, maximum 1440 content host, native window buttons and theme choice.

DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §6 CommandPalette and §8 architecture: Popup/TextBox/ListBox subsequence search, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm and adapters to the existing actions, retaining their confirmation/guard paths.
P-33 approved placeholders: exact headings/body/button, Surface/Border/Radius.L, Space.6 padding/inset, Space.2 body gap, Space.4 button gap, 560 maximum width; no extra text or illustrations.

DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §3/§10: use the existing token scales for rail/popup spacing and focus, real before/after Gece and Gun PNGs, accessible Turkish names and first-paint measurement; existing worklog is unchanged.
